name: season-ramp-spain-mid
description: Rest-season weight at about 40 N (Spain) on 2026-11-15: halfway up the ramp, 0.5, but the rest season is shorter and later than in the UK.
why: The full-rest half-width shrinks with latitude: 60 + (40 - 55) x 29 / 15 = 31 days at 40 N. 31 December minus 15 November is 46 days: weight = 1 - (46 - 31) / 30 = 0.5. Hand computation.
